stories.title: Selection
stories.summary: A list that filters as you type, with groups, badges, and choices that are unavailable with their reason. The answer comes back as the chosen object, not a string.

stories.title: Multi-selection with a preview
stories.summary: Tri-state group checkboxes, a live count and a preview pane beside the list. Ctrl+A selects all, Ctrl+N none and Ctrl+T inverts.

stories.title: Text with validation
stories.summary: A pattern, a length or a scriptblock validates the answer, and the message stays inline until the input is valid.

poster.dark: ? Share name default: Reports Shown to users when they browse the server. › 9reports ✗ Start with a letter; letters, digits, - and _ only enter confirm esc cancel

stories.powershell:
$name = Read-ConsoleText 'Share name' -Default 'Reports' -Pattern '[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,23}' -PatternMessage 'Start with a letter; letters, digits, - and _ only' -Description 'Shown to users when they browse the server.'
Write-ConsoleText -Markup "Creating share [bold]$name[/]"
stories.powershellFull:
Import-Module ConsoleMonster

stories.title: Typed confirmation
stories.summary: For destructive actions the name has to be typed; anything else keeps the prompt open.

poster.dark: ▴ Remove FS01 from the inventory? Its history and reports are deleted too. This cannot be undone. Type FS01 to confirm › FS0 ✗ That doesn't match FS01. enter confirm esc cancel

stories.title: A menu as an app
stories.summary: The Shell layout: a breadcrumb title bar, a sidebar, the content pane and a footer that lists the keys that work right now. Ctrl+K opens the command palette, and the review shows the equivalent command line.

stories.title: A form as a wizard
stories.summary: Fields with pages become a wizard with a progress strip. Dependent fields reload their choices with a spinner, and the review page shows every answer and the equivalent command.

stories.title: The grid
stories.summary: An Out-GridView for the console on 5.1 and 7: typing filters, F3 sorts by column, Space marks rows, Enter shows every column of a row and Ctrl+Enter returns the original objects.
